route_title: 24-Layer HfO2/SiO2 Stack with Relaxed Bounds and Coordinate Perturbation
compilation_rationale: Bounded 24-layer HfO2/SiO2 stack optimized over 300–1700 nm using coherent smatrix. Four soft objectives enforce peak transmission in 1000–1700 nm and peak reflection in 300–450 nm while suppressing cross-band leakage. Thickness tolerances mapped to relative uniform error model. All physics constraints satisfied.
